product.name: Digital Quick Financing
product.description: A fast financing service providing loans from 50 to 3,000 Egyptian pounds with same-day disbursement.

product.name: Micro-Project Financing
product.description: Financing for micro-projects with capital up to 1 million Egyptian pounds, offering loans up to 266,000 pounds with a three-day disbursement period.

product.name: Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) Financing
product.description: Loans from 266,000 up to 15 million Egyptian pounds for small and medium enterprises, with disbursement within one week.

product.name: Leasing Financing
product.description: A financing option allowing businesses to lease production assets with installment payments leading to ownership.

product.name: Product Payment Financing
product.description: A service acting as an intermediary between traders and suppliers to facilitate payment processes.

product.name: Seasonal Financing
product.description: Financing tailored for agricultural and seasonal projects, offering suitable loan amounts and repayment plans aligned with project cycles.
